A.name: Stepped monolithic portal
A.intent: Continuous tall jambs anchor the window; an inset shoulder separates them from engaged end piers and the longitudinal beams.

upper.application: Uniform secondary section along both colonnades, returning into unchanged inner-end wall. No new floor area or route.

transom.role: Thin datum splice aligned to existing field boundary; not a structural lintel.

A.tradeoff: Closest to the primary art's vertical hierarchy and quieter terminal shoulder. The deep jambs narrow the oblique apparent glass width; the thin 0.2 m head zone is a ceiling junction, not evidence of a load-bearing lintel.

B.name: Bridged terminal bay
B.intent: Engaged end piers carry a broad entrance bridge; the lower field sits in an 11.2 m wide recess and the tall window steps back above it.

upper.application: Uniform secondary section along both colonnades, returning into unchanged inner-end wall. No new floor area or route.

transom.role: Proposed architectural bridge tied into engaged end piers, with 0.4 m backing return to the end-wall/glazing datum. Structural feasibility is unresolved; dimensions express visible form.

B.tradeoff: Stronger lateral enclosure and a deliberate pause at the entrance. The bridge competes with the reference's uninterrupted vertical emphasis; upper glazing height reduces by 0.6 m.

approach.status: Wide architectural perspective drawing, aimed toward the entrance centre and tilted upward to include the portal head and adjacent shaft. Not gameplay or a reconstructed source camera; gameplay HFOV remains 90.
